render: HTML/CSS recreation of PetWidget medium family on an iOS 18 home screen. Not a pixel-true WidgetKit snapshot (no Mac/simulator).
screen: iOS 18 home screen: time + location arrow, signal, wifi, battery pill, Dynamic Island, medium widget near top, generic unbranded icon grid, page dots, dock, home indicator.
wallpaper: Soft blurred gray-green landscape, muted to match the real widget screenshot.

widget.chrome: Dark charcoal rounded card, light rim, faint paw pattern, 3D clay pet head left, glowing accent dot + bold label, 4-line clipped message with no ellipsis.

slides.label: Misses You!
slides.message: where did you go. i've been sitting here staring at the door like a dummy. come home already.

slides.label: Mad!
slides.message: i haven't eaten in forever. this is a hostage situation. snacks. now. i'm not kidding around.
slides.note: Hungry is not a WidgetExpression; mad is the food-crisis state.

slides.label: Sleepy!
slides.message: honestly at this point i'm just a ghost haunting this empty bowl. wake me when food.
